source.title: Renewed Iran War Would Test Diminished Interceptor Inventories

summary: CSIS update after the ceasefire collapsed on July 8: fighting since the ceasefire pushed Patriot and THAAD inventories lower, though Iranian launch rates are below the opening weeks.

claims.quote: This has required extensive use of interceptors, with Patriot inventories now under 1,000 and THAAD inventories at about 250.

Resumption of combat operations has reduced inventories further, though Iranian launches have so far been at a lower rate than before the ceasefire.
